name: Plume
description: A plume: the sector bored out at the quill so the feather starts clear of its own root.

code.style: --rule: ( --from: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from @var(--from) at 50% 50%, #000 0 56deg, transparent 0), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 22%, #000 0); mask: conic-gradient(from @var(--from) at 50% 50%, #000 0 56deg, transparent 0), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 22%, #000 0); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
